test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which areas is intensive subsistence agriculture practiced?

options.text: area without population pressure on land
Areas with average population pressure on land
Areas with low population pressure on land
areas with high population pressure on land

solution:
The correct answer is __**areas with high population pressure.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gahana Nirvah Krishi** refers to intensive agriculture, where farmers use **advanced techniques **and **high-quality inputs** to maximize yields from a limited area of land.
 
• It is common in the densely inhabited monsoon regions of **southeast, east, and south Asia.**
 
• In areas with** high population pressure**, farmers practice intensive agriculture to produce **more food from limited land resources** to meet the increasing demand for food.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In areas with** low population pressure**, farmers have more land available, and they can practice** extensive agriculture,** which focuses on producing more food by cultivating a larger area of land.
 
• In areas with** average population pressure**, farmers practice **semi-intensive agriculture,** which is a mix of intensive and extensive agriculture techniques.
 
• In areas with** no population pressure**, farmers may not practice agriculture at all, or they may practice **subsistence agriculture,** which is focused on producing enough food for their own consumption.
